Aman Mittal @amanhimself

RSS Feed

Hi, I'm Aman, a technical writer and a programmer.

Right now, I am working as a documentation engineer at Expo, where I turn complicated things using docs-as-code first approach to help people build React Native apps.

Before Expo, I was a Senior Content Developer at Vercel and a Developer Advocate at Draftbit. I've been writing about programming since 2017, with more than 150 articles across 30+ publications.

This blog is where I write things down as I figure them out and my thoughts. See what I'm up to on my /now page, or learn more about me on my /about page.
